title: The Central Venous Catheter Related Complications in Critically Ill Patients
brief_summary: In this prospective clinical study, the researchers investigate the incidence of catheter-related thrombosis and catheter-related infection during indwelling central venous catheterization in critically ill patients, and analyzed the risk factors for catheter-related complications and the relationship between catheter-related thrombi and catheter-related infections. The sample size is about 500.
study_population: The study population comes from the five critical medical wards of Zhujiang Hospital , including integrated area, cardiovascular severe ward, respiratory severe ward, neurological severe ward and neurosurgical severe ward.
condition: Central Venous Catheter Related Bloodstream Infection
